title: Remote work is about more than just working from home·it mea…

sents.en: Remote work is about more than just working from home·it means working differently.
sents.cn: 远程办公不只是居家办公——它意味着以不同的方式工作。

sents.en: Organizations should reconsider the appropriateness of their performance evaluation procedures in light of the shift to remote work.
sents.cn: 鉴于转向远程办公，组织应重新考量其绩效考核程序的恰当性。

sents.en: This requires a fundamental rethinking of what organizations expect from employees and what companies would look for in a model employee in a remote work context.
sents.cn: 这需要从根本重新思考组织对员工的期望，以及公司在远程办公背景下对"模范员工"的期许。

sents.en: It is likely that the "first to arrive and last to leave" mentality is no longer relevant, but should be replaced by a regard for the quality of an employee's contribution to the organization.
sents.cn: "最早到、最晚走"的心态很可能已不再适用，而应当被对员工组织贡献质量的重视所取代。

sents.en: This means that work should be measured in terms of the quality of the work, not just the quality of the process.
sents.cn: 这意味着工作应以工作质量来衡量，而不仅仅是过程的质量。

sents.en: As remote work is largely unobservable to supervisors, employers need to think about how they can objectively measure the quality of work in a way that is consistent for employees of similar rank.
sents.cn: 由于远程办公在很大程度上主管难以察觉，雇主需要思考如何以对同级别员工一致的方式，客观地衡量工作质量。

sents.en: Focusing on output alone can have unintended consequences.
sents.cn: 仅关注产出可能带来意想不到的后果。

sents.en: Employers should think instead about the values and soft skills they want to emphasize in a remote work environment.
sents.cn: 雇主应转而思考在远程办公环境中想要强调的价值观与软技能。

sents.en: Qualities like flexibility and the ability to work under minimal supervision might become critical.
sents.cn: 诸如灵活性和在最低监督下工作的能力这类素质，可能变得至关重要。

sents.en: Much has been written about the importance of timely feedback.
sents.cn: 关于及时反馈的重要性已有大量论述。

sents.en: In the context of a global pandemic, firms may want to provide additional support to employees by providing more frequent communication.
sents.cn: 在全球大流行的背景下，企业或许希望通过更频繁的沟通为员工提供额外支持。

sents.en: This allows managers to both keep an eye on struggling employees and provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting to their new work environment.
sents.cn: 这让管理者既能留意陷入困境的员工，也能就员工如何适应新工作环境提供持续反馈。

sents.en: Compensation also needs to be revisited.
The purpose of performance evaluation is ultimately to determine how to reward employees for their work.
sents.cn: 绩效考核的最终目的，是确定如何就员工的工作给予奖励。

sents.en: This means that pay structures need to adapt to the reality of working from home.
sents.cn: 这意味着薪酬结构需要适应居家办公的现实。

sents.en: However, organizations also need to be honest with employees about the financial impact of COVID-19.
sents.cn: 然而，组织也需要就新冠疫情的财务影响对员工坦诚相告。

sents.en: For organizations that have struggled to keep the lights on due to the pandemic, this might mean thinking of non-financial ways to reward employees, like unpaid time off or flexible work schedules.
sents.cn: 对于那些因疫情而艰难维持经营的组织，这可能意味着要考虑非财务的奖励方式，比如不带薪休假或弹性工作时间。

sents.en: Employers can also consider how to bundle different types of compensation to help employees cope with their unique situations.
sents.cn: 雇主也可以考虑如何组合不同类型的薪酬，以帮助员工应对各自的独特处境。
